help.q1b: An AI fact-checking service: enter a claim or news URL and it assesses whether it holds up by cross-checking multiple sources.
help.q2b: Your input passes through several stages — analysis, evidence gathering, cross-verification, counter-checking, verdict, and freshness — leaving a step-by-step trail instead of an opaque answer.
help.q3b: Verified — well supported by evidence. Likely True — mostly supported but partly uncertain. Partially True — only partly true. Unverified — not enough linked evidence to judge. False — refuted by evidence.
help.q4b: This is an AI-generated analysis and can be wrong. Review the sources and reasoning in each report; the final judgment is yours.
help.q5b: For questions and feedback, reach us via annverify.ai.
